queries.name: table_shape_constraints_indexes
queries.sentinels: Stop if row count>200 or any over_definition_byte_limit=true; no truncation acceptance
queries.query:
BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY;
SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '8s';
WITH wanted(schema_name,table_name) AS (VALUES ('public','forge_game_update_queue'),('public','forge_runs'),('public','forge_game_revisions'),('public','games')), rel AS (
 SELECT w.*,c.oid,c.relkind,c.relowner,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity
 FROM wanted w LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.nspname=w.schema_name
 LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.relnamespace=n.oid AND c.relname=w.table_name
), rows AS (
 SELECT 'relation'::text kind,schema_name,table_name,'_'::text item,
 jsonb_build_object('exists',oid IS NOT NULL,'kind',relkind,'owner',pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(relowner),'rls',relrowsecurity,'forceRls',relforcerowsecurity) detail FROM rel
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'column',r.schema_name,r.table_name,a.attname::text,jsonb_build_object('ordinal',a.attnum,'type',pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'notNull',a.attnotnull,'default',pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid))
 FROM rel r JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=r.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
 LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=r.oid AND d.adnum=a.attnum
 WHERE r.table_name='forge_game_update_queue'
 OR r.table_name='games' AND a.attname IN ('id','startTime','homeTeamId','awayTeamId')
 OR r.table_name='forge_runs' AND a.attname IN ('run_id','status','updated_at','metrics')
 OR r.table_name='forge_game_revisions' AND a.attname IN ('id','game_id','run_id','decision_as_of','published_at')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'constraint',r.schema_name,r.table_name,c.conname::text,jsonb_build_object('type',c.contype,'definition',pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid,true)) FROM rel r JOIN pg_catalog.pg_constraint c ON c.conrelid=r.oid
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'index',r.schema_name,r.table_name,i.indexrelid::regclass::text,jsonb_build_object('unique',i.indisunique,'valid',i.indisvalid,'definition',pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid)) FROM rel r JOIN pg_catalog.pg_index i ON i.indrelid=r.oid
) SELECT * FROM rows ORDER BY schema_name,table_name,kind,item LIMIT 201;
COMMIT;

queries.name: table_schema_rpc_grants_and_rls
queries.sentinels: Stop if row count>200 or any over_definition_byte_limit=true; no truncation acceptance
queries.query:
BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY;
SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '8s';
WITH wanted(schema_name,table_name) AS (VALUES ('public','forge_game_update_queue'),('public','forge_runs'),('public','forge_game_revisions'),('public','games')), rows AS (
 SELECT 'table_acl'::text kind,w.schema_name,w.table_name AS object_name,
 jsonb_build_object('acl',c.relacl,'owner',pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner)) detail
 FROM wanted w LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.nspname=w.schema_name LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.relnamespace=n.oid AND c.relname=w.table_name
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'schema_acl',n.nspname,'_',jsonb_build_object('acl',n.nspacl,'owner',pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner)) FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace n WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','fhfh_internal')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'policy',p.schemaname,p.tablename||':'||p.policyname,jsonb_build_object('roles',p.roles,'command',p.cmd,'permissive',p.permissive,'using',p.qual,'check',p.with_check)
 FROM pg_catalog.pg_policies p JOIN wanted w ON w.schema_name=p.schemaname AND w.table_name=p.tablename
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'effective_schema_acl',n.nspname,r.rolname,jsonb_build_object('usage',pg_catalog.has_schema_privilege(r.oid,n.oid,'USAGE'),'create',pg_catalog.has_schema_privilege(r.oid,n.oid,'CREATE')) FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace n CROSS JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles r WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','fhfh_internal') AND r.rolname IN ('anon','authenticated','service_role')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'effective_table_acl',w.schema_name,w.table_name||':'||r.rolname,jsonb_build_object('select',pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'SELECT'),'insert',pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'INSERT'),'update',pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'UPDATE'),'delete',pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'DELETE'))
 FROM wanted w JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.nspname=w.schema_name JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.relnamespace=n.oid AND c.relname=w.table_name CROSS JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname IN ('anon','authenticated','service_role')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'effective_function_acl',n.nspname,p.proname||'('||pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)||'):'||r.rolname,jsonb_build_object('execute',pg_catalog.has_function_privilege(r.oid,p.oid,'EXECUTE'))
 FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN (VALUES ('public','claim_starter_board_jobs'),('public','finish_starter_board_job'),('fhfh_internal','enqueue_starter_board_game'),('fhfh_internal','enqueue_starter_board_observation'),('fhfh_internal','enqueue_starter_board_resolution'),('public','enqueue_forge_cadence_slot'),('fhfh_internal','advance_forge_cadence_slots')) AS f(schema_name,function_name) ON f.schema_name=n.nspname AND f.function_name=p.proname CROSS JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname IN ('anon','authenticated','service_role')
) SELECT * FROM rows ORDER BY kind,schema_name,object_name LIMIT 201;
COMMIT;
